correctness.rationale: Mean-unbiasedness uses exponential survival integration and conditional uniform sampling. Expanding errors through h-prime, memorylessness gives the endpoint kernel eta^2 exp(-max/eta) and Bernoulli covariance gives interior kernel eta min(u,v)exp(-max/eta). Both kernels have total mass 2 eta^4; constant vector derivatives attain it; smooth positive bumps on either side of eta give opposite signs in the exact kernel difference; smooth test-function separation proves uniqueness. A packaged checker verifies 19,525 polynomial coefficient configurations using exact rational arithmetic. Finite experiments do not establish the infinite-dimensional proof, which is given analytically.

value.rationale: The baseline single-endpoint rule has nonzero quadratic path RMS error eta*||h(0)||; exactly quadratic-exact corrections remove this and have sharp curvature-dependent RMS sqrt(2)*L*eta^2. Two concrete oracle designs have the same minimax bound but opposite risk ordering for smooth low- versus high-position curvature, making a meaningful evaluation-cost/error and sampling-location boundary; no full-optimizer-rate claim is made.
